At billing, you presented a completely torn ₹500 note. As per basic financial norms, we asked you to replace it which is standard procedure anyone will follow. Plus, walking in without an appointment, interfering with equipment and offering damaged currency! 
It is easy to post a one-sided version online. It is harder to acknowledge one’s own actions.

At Zenia’s, we stand by our service, our staff and our standards.
